# A. J. Ayer

*1910 – 1989 · British · [Logical positivism](../movements/logical-positivism.md)*

British philosopher who brought logical positivism to the English-speaking world with Language, Truth and Logic (1936), a lively manifesto of the verification principle and of moral emotivism.
